null_semantics: unknown or not yet collected; never assumed zero, false, empty history, or nonexistent irrigation
validation_rules: Closed non-self-intersecting polygon within supported AOI; compute geodesic area rather than trusting reported area.
Sowing <= transplant <= harvest when events apply; distinguish planned from observed dates.
pH 0..14 and laboratory method/depth/date required; total N is not available N.
Null history means unknown; [] may mean no records only when respondent explicitly confirms this.
Farm-gate prices require crop, unit, quality, currency, location and date; costs require area/time basis.
Weights 0..1 and sum to 1 only after user selection; do not assume priorities.
SoilGrids/GAEZ values must be stored as model-derived layers, never inserted into soil_lab as measured values.
